layers.label: block1_conv2
layers.descriptor: Early VGG16 features group stimulus triplets through local texture and contrast patterns.

layers.label: block2_conv2
layers.descriptor: Contour-level cues begin to separate the stimulus groups into broader visual families.

layers.label: block3_conv3
layers.descriptor: Mid-level VGG16 layers emphasize reusable parts and larger local motifs in the triplets.

layers.label: block4_conv3
layers.descriptor: Later VGG16 layers reflect broader visual neighborhoods between the stimulus groups.

layers.label: block5_conv2
layers.descriptor: Category identity becomes more stable and cross-group separation is easier to read.

layers.label: block5_conv3
layers.descriptor: The deepest selected VGG16 layer emphasizes higher-level category structure over surface detail.

layers.label: semantic_embedding
layers.descriptor: Semantic similarity is computed from GloVe word embeddings, averaging the category words that define each stimulus triplet.
